PSG secured a thrilling 3-2 victory over Nice in Ligue 1 2026/27!
Mohamed Amoura gave Nice an early lead before Senny Mayulu and Désiré Doué turned things around for PSG. Ferran Torres added a crucial third, while Ali Abdi's late goal set up a nervy finish.
